Claude Fable 5 is a beast… but also the biggest party pooper 😅

I just released a new video showing how I created a full on-scroll animation experience using Claude Fable 5. The result was honestly crazy.

But now… Claude Fable 5 is not available. Perfect timing, right? 😂

This video is not only about Claude Fable 5. It’s about the workflow.

I used Codex to analyze the website inspiration, study the scroll animations, break down the motion, and help me write a detailed prompt.

Then I used Claude Fable 5 to generate the full landing page experience. And now that Claude Fable 5 is not available, you can still use the same workflow with Gemini 3.1 Pro or any strong coding model.

Claude Fable 5 may have left the party early, but the process is still alive. New video is live 👇

I GAVE 4 AI MODELS THE SAME 3 PROMPTS AND THEY GAVE ME 4 DIFFERENT PERSONALITIES

prompt 1: build a fluid simulation 
prompt 2: make a 2d game where a moon rover runs from an octopus 
prompt 3: render a black hole with gravitational lensing

same 3 prompts. 4 models. zero overlap.

claude fable 5 made cinematic 2d fluid that actually splashes. then a pixel-art rover with earth glowing in the corner. then a black hole that looks like the gargantua scene from interstellar

claude opus 4.8 built a settings panel with gravity sliders. added a hud with energy, shield and threat level to the game. labeled the black hole SAGITTARIUS A* and drew a relativistic jet

gemini 3.1 pro reinterpreted "fluid sim" as an hourglass with sand falling through a neck. put the octopus on the moon surface and animated its tentacles. softened the black hole into gold lensing

gpt 5.5 built a 3d particle bowl spinning under centrifugal force. added a title screen to the game and made the octopus literally yell "HUMAN! MEET YOUR DOOM!" then rendered the black hole as vector dots like a telescope feed

fable is the cinematographer opus is the engineer gemini is the interpreter gpt is the storyteller

most people will keep asking "which model is best"

pick the one whose personality matches your problem
